moworks.notes: Target moves 0 → 1 on stiffness 300, damping 34.64 = 2√300, mass 1 (damping ratio exactly 1): no overshoot, within 1 % by ~380 ms. Kit form: springk(300, 34.64) over 0.38 s. Rule: the fastest stop without overshoot. Small demo: the target moves 102 px beside the response graph, with overshoot and settle readouts. Params: stiffness (300) · damping (34.64 = 2√k) · duration (0.38 s). Damping 2√k: the fastest stop without overshoot, ~0.38 s.
